premises.text: Remote clinics lack bulky/expensive hospital imaging tools patients need
premises.evidence_span: Many tools are available in large hospitals. are not accessible because they are expensive or too bulky

premises.text: iPad-based ultrasound brings diagnosis and specialist connection to local clinics
premises.evidence_span: We have built a new ultrasound solution working on an iPad

premises.text: Workflow captures images, adjusts contrast, annotates, measures, and records notes including speech-to-text
premises.evidence_span: I can adjust contrast and brightness with one finger

premises.text: Practitioners can send images and call specialists over cellular or Wi-Fi for remote advice
premises.evidence_span: maybe I can call a more experienced doctor in a major city hospital to get advice

premises.text: Device priced at 14,900 euros—about one third of regular ultrasound—for emergency use
premises.evidence_span: 14,900 euros, Ausgut is a great tool for emergency. This is one third of the price of the regular ultrasound device

premises.text: Also suited to education by broadcasting the image stream to a classroom audience
premises.evidence_span: ideal tool for healthcare classroom, because you can instantly broadcast the image stream to a large audience

premises.text: CE Medical and FDA approvals are on track to unlock US and European sales
premises.evidence_span: CE Medical and FDA are on track to be approved by mid-next year, which will allow us to sell to US and European markets
